clips.title: The story
paras: At the Stonewrought Dam, suspicious powder puts Loch Modan and Ironforge in danger. Ashlan Stonesmirk in Dun Modr identifies it as unstable Seaforium, which can explode catastrophically when it touches water.

Ashlan Stonesmirk recognizes the silver crystals and distinct odor in samples from the Stonewrought Dam as Seaforium. It stays inert while dry, but moisture makes it react violently. An unchecked explosion could blow Ironforge out of the mountain, Ashlan warns.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This ain't no ordinary blast powder. Look at the tiny silver crystals. And the distinct smell! Why it's clear as daylight that this is Seaforium Powder. Seaforium is harmless enough. But once it's wet it could blow Ironforge out of the mountain.
The chemical reaction can be defused by mixing four components: lurker venom, crushed Mo'Grosh crystal, a crocolisk tear and this disarming colloid. Now tell Hinderweir before it's too late!

clips.title: Progress
paras: What is that you bring from Ashlan?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A disarming colloid? For Seaforium? Oh heavens!
